reviews.text: Great FREE app!. I looked everywhere for a truly free yoga app. Seems I may have found one .
Excellent for Free App. This is the only yoga app I’ve found that is truly free. It does what I need. I like being able to choose the time length & that it does the thinking for me.
In love. I lost everything in my last phone, including my yoga app. I didn’t think I’d ever find anything I liked. I found an app that’s better, thank you!
A great way to get back into yogo. I’m so out of shape, but this free app is helping me get back up and get working. Lovely!
Great App. Great App and great Work outs
Good but…. You can only skip once. Some of these are not for anyone that’s a beginning and you should be able to skip them. Not everyone can left their leg over their head
Easy for a beginner. Easy to follow along

Workouts for beginners. Love the simplicity and effectiveness of these small workouts, ranging from 10-40 min. 
First impression but excited to move forward.
How I rate this app. It’s the only good one that’s free but I wish there could be one for losing weight and getting skinnier. But over all it’s good and free!

Great intro lessons for newbies. For someone who’s never done yoga before, but always wanted to try, this was the perfect way to get started. Not only is it making me feel more aware about my body, it’s making me feel stronger and the music that goes with the exercise routines really centers me for the day.

Best app. I love this app the lessons are short a really easy plus I love that the instructor doesn’t talk a lot so I get to relax and listen to the music while I focus on my breathing and I lost a lot of weight doing these exercises
Love it. I did it!! Thank you. Love it! And its free!!

Awesome App!!. I love this app. I don’t have much time so I like that the sessions are short. I also like how it tells you what’s coming up next. There’s a calendar to keep your progresses and its 100% free. Totally recommend it!!
Sorry far so good!. Clear instructions plenty of time between moves. So far I really like it.
Yoga. Excellent easy app to fit in exercise. A wide variety to chose from for whatever fits your day. It’s relaxing and helps me with my running.

New yogi. I am so new to the yoga world, well in this current body shape anyway. No longer able to work has done a number on me. Not to mention “the BIG change” we, as females go thru, really packed on the pounds. I love the fact it’s FREE and I can do it in my time anywhere I find my space. Can’t wait for the weather to be warmer, I can take it outside! It’s easy to follow instruction, and doesn’t take too long. Before you know it you’re done and wanting to do more.
Great for beginners. Just started using so I haven’t seen any results. Mostly using this to learn basic moves since I’m very new to yoga. So far it been a great tool to help me start.

Yoga online. This is truly been the best app , I have found! It’s exactly the same as going to the yoga classes . I get to practice each yoga pose and perfect them in the Comfort of my own home. Due to Covid the yoga studio was closed but thanks to this app I can still reach my body goals. Thanks for making this app so easy for all ages to use.
Amazing!. This app makes it easy for me to get 30 minute workouts every single day when my little one goes down for a nap. I feel amazing!
Get both beginner. Get for me whom had never done yoga but always been interested in trying
Great way to ease into yoga. Simple with lots of variety. I appreciate that you can pick a shorter workout or longer.
Newbie success. Like the rest periods to get ready for next poses

BEST APP EVER!!!!!!!!!!. This is the first app that I used where I haven’t stopped after the first couple of poses cause I was out of breath. If you have nots in your neck or is just out of place I recommend using this app. I give this app a 11 out of 10!!
This app is great. I am a beginner to yoga and this app makes it easy for me to learn. The beginner exercise are challenging for someone who is out of shape like me but easy to do.
Yoga. I love this app exercise
Excellent. I was able to start to exercise my mind n body.
Great app. Great app all the workout are easy to follow and the background music is very relaxing
Retirement yoga. First time… looking forward to getting better!

Newbie. Easy to follow but extra instructions if needed. A variety of workouts for different stages of experience (I’m a beginner) nice relaxing background music. And it actually is free unlike most other apps that advertise as free but really aren’t.
Mrs. Easy, feeling good afterwards!
First time using. Absolutely love this app it fits into my busy work schedule which I have found really difficult for other apps to do! I would definitely recommend it 🙏🏽

Easy yet burns calories. Really enjoying this. Started last week and been able to do only a couple of times, yet with each use I feel the calories burn, muscles stretching and a general feeling of well-being. 
I especially love that it has different categories for different needs. I also love that it has reminders each day in case I forget or don’t feel too motivated for the day, it doesn’t guilt trip me but provides a gentle reminder.
I also love that it connects to the Health App on my iPhone and records my yoga exercise and how many calories I burn. 
Over all the best I’ve tried so far. 
Kudos to you guys!
Best one. Loving this app …very thankful to the developer.

Fab! Fab!. One of the best yoga app’s I’ve found and used, love this one and it’s good that you can set it with your phone and get reminders to do yoga, has a busy mom finding time between sorting kids, housework and yoga I can now find my time with my youngest in nursery so I get to use this app and have set reminders for 9am everyday 7 days a week.
